summary.text: Martin LaLonde is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-12 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Martin LaLonde was born in Lynwood, California, and lives in Vermont.
LaLonde earned a bachelor's degree in business administration and a J.D. from the University of Michigan.

LaLonde worked in sales before law school and then as an attorney, clerking for Judge John Butzner of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit and Judge Paul Friedman of the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, and working in the Department of Justice's Environment and Natural Resources division.
LaLonde served on the South Burlington school board from 2010 to 2021.
In the 2023-2024 session, LaLonde chaired the House Judiciary Committee.
